svg.aria-label: Experience — three roles at once in 2026. Full Stack Developer, mesoestetic® Pharma Group (Sep 2026 – now · Viladecans, hybrid · training contract): Internal app for the group, built in a team of four. Confidential — happy to talk it through. AI-assisted development: Claude Code and MCP built into the team's daily workflow. Won mesoestetic's challenge at MetròpolisFPLab (Fundació BCN FP · Barcelona Metropolitan Area). Stack: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind 4, PostgreSQL, Radix UI, Recharts. QA Testing, PROVEN (Jul 2026 – now · remote · part-time): QA for a platform that validates real skills via self-assessment and anonymous peer review. Jira backlog shaped into epics, problems and features; defects followed from report to close. Mentored by Jon Kern, co-author of the Agile Manifesto, on agile delivery practice. Stack: Jira, Confluence, Playwright, Agile. Full Stack Developer, ESYPA CASA · reformas integrales (Apr 2026 – now · Barcelona, hybrid · part-time): Internal app replacing a manual process with an automated one — real people depend on it. I set up and run its infrastructure: private VPS, domain and DNS on Cloudflare, n8n workflows. AI with clear limits: the model structures and drafts, but never decides the numbers. Stack: TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Docker, n8n, Cloudflare.
